name: session
description: Session lifecycle and workspace skills: resume an interrupted turn, audit or hand off a session, arm a rate-limit safety net, defer a command, and spawn or tear down an isolated git worktree.

interface.shortDescription: Resume, close, hand off, schedule, and isolate a coding session
interface.longDescription: Session bundles the eight skills that bracket a working session. restart picks up a turn that died to an API error, an OOM, an auth expiry, or an ESC, and resumes it in single-tool-call chunks. close audits four categories of leftover work read-only and prints an [OK] or [BLOCKED] verdict without touching the repo. handoff writes unfinished work into a tracking issue comment plus an agent-local memory file so the next session can resume from one sentence. rate-limit-guard arms a cron at the token-limit reset time and resume-after-limit is what that cron invokes; together they carry an overnight run across one or more reset windows. schedule defers any slash command by N minutes. worktree-spawn creates the isolated git worktree a parallel agent works in, and worktree-teardown removes it, deletes the branch, and syncs main. The three cron skills need Claude Code's CronCreate/CronDelete tools and cannot run elsewhere; the two worktree skills are plain git CLI and run everywhere.
defaultPrompt: Resume from where the last turn died.
Can I close this session, or is something unfinished?
Spawn a worktree for this issue.
